summary: A PROJECT SIZE range filter at the top of the filter stack: two handles over a ladder of round MW values from 1 to 5,000, plus number boxes for an exact band. Shareable in the URL as mw_min and mw_max.
modification_note: This cartridge is NOT panel-only. It adds a filter row above the technology buttons and a clause to the filter predicate, so it patches the filter loop, the URL sync, the hydrate and the clear.

registry_entry.activation: inline control; no payload, no fetch
registry_entry.mutates_existing_dashboard: adds a PROJECT SIZE range filter and the mw_min / mw_max URL parameters

scale.why_not_linear: Measured over all 7,680 projects the median is 12.3 MW, the 75th percentile is 40 MW and 98% sit under 500 MW. A linear 1-5000 track would put the 30-40 MW band inside 0.2% of its length. The ladder thickens where the register is dense and still reaches 5,000.
scale.exact_values: The number boxes accept any value in range, so a band the ladder does not carry is still reachable. Only the slider snaps.

registry_entry.filters_only: This is a view control. It never redefines the pipeline: the register's own floor is 1 MW, the largest record is 4,100 MW, and clearing the filter restores every qualifying record.
